tutorial.title: How to use Shot Caller
tutorial.say: Welcome to Shot Caller. This quick guide shows how to use it the right way: what a call means, how to act on it, and how to protect your money.

tutorial.title: 1 · Install
tutorial.say: Shot Caller is a web app. Open the website. On iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, tap the menu, then Install app.

tutorial.title: 2 · Get access
tutorial.say: Tap Get access to buy a pass. Already paid on another phone? Tap Sign in and enter your code.

tutorial.title: 3 · The Deck
tutorial.say: The Deck tab is home. Most of the time it says Sit out. That is normal. The bot only calls when a round clears its bar, and waiting is part of the plan.

tutorial.title: 4 · A call
tutorial.say: When it finds one, you see UP or DOWN, the target bitcoin has to beat at the close, and a confidence score. Calls are priced between sixty and ninety cents, so a win pays at least ten cents a dollar.

tutorial.title: 5 · Placing it
tutorial.say: The buy box shows the price and the most you should pay. Place the trade yourself on Kalshi, and never pay more than that maximum. Then tap, I bought it, so the app can track your position.

tutorial.title: 6 · Tracking
tutorial.say: Your position card shows what it is worth now, what it pays if it wins, and whether to hold or sell.

tutorial.title: 7 · Bail out
tutorial.say: If the round turns against the call, you get a bail out alert. Act on it quickly. Selling early keeps part of your money, instead of risking all of it.

tutorial.title: 8 · The radar
tutorial.say: The Chart tab has the market radar: the likely range for the close, the target line, and every exchange as a blip. It explains the call. It is not a separate call.

tutorial.title: 9 · Alerts
tutorial.say: In Settings, turn on push notifications, so calls and bail alerts reach you even with the app closed.

tutorial.title: 10 · Loss limit
tutorial.say: Set a daily loss limit. Once your tracked trades lose that much in a day, buy alerts stop until midnight.

tutorial.title: 11 · The record
tutorial.say: The Record tab grades every call against Kalshi's result. Judge it by profit after fees, not win rate. An eighty cent call should win about eighty percent of the time.

tutorial.title: Use it well
tutorial.say: Trade small, follow the bail alerts, respect the pauses, and remember: every call can lose. Shot Caller gives signals, not guarantees.

disclaimer.title: Important
disclaimer.say: Important information about Shot Caller. Please read before you trade.

disclaimer.title: Not financial advice
disclaimer.say: Shot Caller gives signals for information only. It is not financial advice, and nobody behind it is a financial adviser.

disclaimer.title: You can lose money
disclaimer.say: Trading event contracts is risky. Every call can lose, and you can lose all the money you put into a trade. Only trade what you can afford to lose.

disclaimer.title: No guarantees
disclaimer.say: Past results do not guarantee future results. Win rates and profits shown in the app are records, not promises.

disclaimer.title: Not affiliated with Kalshi
disclaimer.say: Shot Caller is independent. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Kalshi.

disclaimer.title: Your trades, your decision
disclaimer.say: Shot Caller does not place trades for you, unless you turn on the optional Auto-trader with your own Kalshi keys. Every trade is your decision and your responsibility.

disclaimer.title: 18 and older
disclaimer.say: Kalshi is for people eighteen and older, where it is available. Check that it is legal where you live.
